title: Web application environment: one decision trace
teachingQuestion: What does web application environment require beyond completing a technical action?
focalInsight: Validate inputs server-side, enforce authorization on protected operations, and encode output for the actual output context.
caption: Follow the concept from meaning to the decision condition and its concrete failure consequence.

nodes.label: Web application environment
nodes.definition: The browser, service, session and data-processing contexts through which a web application accepts input and produces output.
